meta.title: Hikari - Premium Japanese Dining in Tabuk
meta.description: An exceptional Japanese dining experience in the heart of Al-Masif, Tabuk. Fresh sushi, omakase, and an atmosphere inspired by authentic Japanese beauty.

hero.title: Hikari
hero.subtitle: Where Light Meets Flavor
hero.description: An authentic Japanese dining experience in the heart of Tabuk, where the ancient art of Japanese cuisine is revealed in every dish we craft with meticulous care and attention to the finest details.

omakase_experience.title: The Art of Omakase
omakase_experience.subtitle: Let the Chef Guide Your Journey
omakase_experience.description: Omakase is not merely a meal -- it is a silent dialogue between chef and guest. Entrust yourself to our chef's expertise and savor a carefully curated selection of the finest seasonal ingredients, prepared before you with precision and mastery.

features.title: Seasonal Ingredients
features.description: We select the finest fresh ingredients according to the seasons, ensuring the highest quality and flavor in every dish.

features.title: Japanese Craftsmanship
features.description: Every piece of sushi tells a story from Japan's rich culinary heritage of preparation and presentation.

features.title: An Exclusive Experience
features.description: Limited seating ensures every guest receives a personal experience with exceptional attention to detail.

ambiance.title: A World of Tranquility
ambiance.subtitle: Design Inspired by Zen Philosophy
ambiance.description: Every corner of Hikari is designed as an extension of Japanese aesthetic philosophy. From carefully considered ambient lighting to natural wood and stone, each element contributes to creating an atmosphere of serenity and refinement that transforms your meal into a complete sensory experience.

features.title: Authentic Japanese Interior
features.description: Natural materials and clean lines reflecting the essence of Japanese architecture

features.title: Considered Lighting
features.description: Precisely calibrated warm lighting providing an intimate and comfortable atmosphere

features.title: Private Seating
features.description: Separate sections offering privacy for families and special occasions

reservation.title: Reserve Your Experience
reservation.subtitle: Your Table Awaits
reservation.description: To reserve and ensure the finest experience, reach out to us via WhatsApp. Our team is ready to accommodate your special requirements and arrange your occasions.
reservation.note: We recommend advance booking, especially on weekends and special occasions.

testimonials.title: Words from Our Guests
testimonials.subtitle: 354 Reviews with a 4.5 out of 5 Rating

items.text: The finest Japanese restaurant I have visited in the entire region. The quality and attention to detail rivals the premium restaurants of Riyadh and Jeddah.
items.author: Ahmed M.

items.text: The omakase experience was exceptional. The chef presents each piece with remarkable skill and visible passion. The space is elegant and the service impeccable.
items.author: Noura A.

items.text: Our third visit and we never tire of it. Each time we discover new flavors. A perfect venue for special occasions and refined evenings.
items.author: Faisal K.
